item.title: Video | Swansea and Cardiff legends unite to raise money for Jason Bowen | Swansea
item.description: Legends of Swansea City and Cardiff City came together at Penybont FC last Sunday to help raise money for Jason Bowen, following the former Wales international’s diagnosis with Motor Neurone Disease.

item.title: Fan gallery | Swansea City v Coventry City | Swansea
item.description: A big thank you to all the Jacks for your brilliant support as Swansea City took on Coventry City. You can view a selection of pictures of the home fans at the Swansea.com Stadium with our gallery.

item.title: Report | Cardiff City Women 2 Swansea City Women 1 | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City Women were narrowly beaten 2-1 by Cardiff City despite another spirited South Wales derby performance.

item.title: Yzzy Taylor | We will get the results if we continue to perform to a high level | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City Women head coach Yzzy Taylor has told her side results will come their way if they continue to believe in themselves and produce the levels of performance they have shown over recent weeks.

item.title: Eilish Mitchell | We have to take the positives and move forward | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City midfielder Eilish Mitchell admits it has been a frustrating couple of weeks in terms of results, but insists there are plenty of positives to take into the remainder of the season following Sunday's 2-1 defeat to Cardiff City.

item.title: Season Ticket Renewals Now Available | 2026-27 | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City can confirm that season ticket renewals are now available for the 2026-27 season.

item.title: Swansea City to host Easter Egg hunt at the Swansea.com Stadium | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City will host a Junior Jacks Easter Egg hunt at the Swansea.com Stadium on April 1, 2026.

item.title: Tickets still available for Swans Women’s final home game at the Swansea.com Stadium | Swansea
item.description: Swansea City Women return to the Swansea.com Stadium for the final time this season on Sunday, March 29 (2pm kick-off), as they face The New Saints, with tickets and a range of offers available for supporters to come and back the team.
